name: application-inline-edit-field
title: Inline Edit Field
description: Click-to-edit text that swaps to an input with save/cancel affordances, keyboard shortcuts (Enter to save, Escape to cancel), and a hover-revealed edit icon.
useWhen: Editing a single short value (name, title, label) without navigating to a separate form or opening a modal.
The field lives inside a settings row or table cell where a full form would be disproportionate.
You want an explicit save/cancel commit step rather than saving on every keystroke.
avoidWhen: The value requires validation feedback, multiple related fields, or a multi-line editor — use a real form instead.
Autosave on every change is the desired behavior — this component only commits on explicit save (Enter or the check button).
The field must always be visibly editable — this component starts in a read-only display state by design.
responsiveBehavior: The control is inline-sized to its content in both states; ensure the containing row has enough width for the input plus its save/cancel buttons when editing.
accessibility: The display-state trigger is a real button with an aria-label announcing the field name and current value.
The input has an associated (visually hidden) label tied via htmlFor/id.
Enter commits and Escape cancels, matching native inline-edit keyboard conventions; blur also commits.
Save and Cancel are separate buttons with explicit aria-labels, not icon-only ambiguity.

variants.title: Inline edit field
variants.description: Display state with a hover-revealed edit icon, and the editing state with save/cancel buttons, shown side by side on a light surface.
accessibility: Save and cancel actions use mousedown preventDefault so clicking them doesn't blur-commit before the click registers.

variants.title: Inline edit field (Dark)
variants.description: Display and editing states adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Input border and focus-ring colors must meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark background.
